title: Worker conversation disclosure and stable read status
description: Use private GATEWAY_PORT/VITE_PORT, an owned headless Agent Chrome FARMSLOT_CDP_PORT, FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EVIDENCE and ffmpeg. Uses the real mounted consumers and observed socket/cache adapter with a controlled fixture. No native host, provider, device or gateway activation. To reproduce the original UI, select its archived FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_UI_ROOT and FARMSLOT_LAYOUT_EXPECT_SHIFT=1.

prove.intent: Open the actual conversation through its shared disclosure, reload to verify the saved choice, and observe genuine protocol failure/refresh/recovery responses. Verify Family and Terminal open/close across reloads, refuse finished-run terminal restoration and surface an unsupported inventory before selection. Require retained transcript, a fixed status row, no raw source error, real 60-second outage admission and no native commands at 1280px and 414px. Save source-timed recordings and screenshots.

result.intent: Require all mounted-client assertions and owned teardown to pass.
